name: Validate Model

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'default-model/**'
      - 'corpus-stats/**'
      - 'akaza-data/**'
      - '.github/workflows/validate-model.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'default-model/**'
      - 'corpus-stats/**'
      - 'akaza-data/**'
      - '.github/workflows/validate-model.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate-corpus:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          # Install any specific dependencies required by validate.py if they exist in a requirements file
          if [ -f "default-model/requirements.txt" ]; then
            pip install -r default-model/requirements.txt
          fi

      - name: Validate Corpus
        run: |
          python3 default-model/scripts/validate.py

  validate-rust:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Run library tests
        run: cargo test --lib

  build-akaza-data:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Build akaza-data
        run: cargo build --release -p akaza-data
